scope: Completed Luna Max run, including recorded pre-interruption and resumed usage. Excludes parent preparation and review.
interpretation: Reasoning is included in output_tokens, and cached input is included in input_tokens. No double counting. Dollar figures are API-equivalent estimates, not billing records. Interrupted unreported generation may not appear in these totals.
